details: Chinese refiners have suspended oil product exports for October, prioritizing domestic supply. This action is attributed to disruptions stemming from the ongoing Iran war affecting Middle Eastern crude supplies and Ukrainian attacks on Russian refining infrastructure. This move is expected to further constrict already war-constrained global fuel markets, potentially leading to higher prices in various countries.
title: China Halts October Fuel Exports, Tightening Global Markets

details: Explosions were reported overnight in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia's capital. Sources linked to the opposition alliance fighting government forces in the country's north claimed responsibility, stating they carried out several drone strikes targeting military headquarters. This escalation marks a significant development in the renewed conflict, raising concerns about wider regional destabilization in the Horn of Africa.
title: Explosions Heard in Ethiopian Capital Amid Renewed Northern Conflict
